clips.name: orbit
clips.note: rings 0 and 2 run clockwise, ring 1 counter-clockwise, 70 deg/s

notes: Each arc is 110 deg of an ellipse. In Rive build each ring as the full ellipse stroke with a Trim Path (start 0, end 0.3056, offset = 120j/360) and animate the trim offset; the SVG draws the full ellipse with data-trim-end/-offset giving the t=0 trim.
